items.fromString:
{color:#008da6}*Reproduce Steps:*{color}

* Create customer 
* Create overdue liability
* Create LPF 
* Pay LPF with payment
* Reverse payment
* Check fines reversal and lpf (is not covered)

{color:#bf2600}*Actual Result:*{color}

Payment reverse process does not offset LPF and Reversal_of_LPF in each other. This missed functionality provokes bigger issue on online payment process.

* Online payment is looking for overdue liability and creates payment, with more amount than liability’s initial amount. This process creates LPF as well, then pays both LPF liability and original liability.
* After payment reverse LPF liability stays uncovered
* New request for amount check returns more amount for liabilities (because of uncovered LPF liability)
* {color:#bf2600}As a result new payment post with easypay will provoke new LPF creation with more amount. When collection channel has checked combine liabilities{color}

{color:#006644}*Expected Result:*{color}

Needs clarification about this topic, should we offset LPF and it’s reversal after every payment reverse proces?

_________________

content.text: Check fines reversal and lpf (is not covered)
Payment reverse process does not offset LPF and Reversal_of_LPF in each other. This missed functionality provokes bigger issue on online payment process.

Online payment is looking for overdue liability and creates payment, with more amount than liability’s initial amount. This process creates LPF as well, then pays both LPF liability and original liability.
After payment reverse LPF liability stays uncovered
New request for amount check returns more amount for liabilities (because of uncovered LPF liability)
As a result new payment post with easypay will provoke new LPF creation with more amount. When collection channel has checked combine liabilities
If payment was reversed then LPF also should be reversed and the liability from LPF should be directly covered with the receivable from reversed LPF
EPR team is waiting for clarification from Asterbit (discussed on online call) before give the approval or disapproval on this issue.
Could you please remind me what you are waiting for from our side exactly?
Please, share the info from the discussions that you had with Asterbit team.
If payment was reversed then LPF also should be reversed and the liability from LPF should be directly covered with the receivable from reversed LPF
The issue is still the same. The LPF liability was paid via a payment object, and then the payment was reversed. As a result, the LPF is not covered.
Receivable-27314 and Liability-100128 have not been offset with each other
Is this case fixed in dev, can we test it?
Hi Valeri, it’s currently merged into both Dev and Test
Receivable generated by Payment reverse → LPF reverse
Expected: The liability and receivable mentioned above should  offset with each other.
